snippet.title: Two stages of J2ME flip-phone Pacman
snippet.description:
I am getting really into late-2000s Java 2 Mobile Edition games for flip phones. I just loaded up Namco's Pacman port for this platform and was bowled over completely by what a solid job they did. I'm pretty sure this is an arcade-perfect conversion, with the sole exception of the sound effects; owing to J2MEs strange allergy to PCM sounds, everything you hear comes from the General MIDI wavetable in the phone. Despite this miserable limitation, Bandai-Namco did an astonishing job of replicating the original sound effects. The pill-eating sound is pretty bad, but the others are masterful abuses of the more unusual GM patches to produce surprisingly competent replicas. Great job!

2:12 - Death sound
2:32 - Intermission song
